boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the University Avenue corridor beside UC Riverside, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: University Village
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor at Iowa Avenue
cards.notes: Start at this open-air center on University Avenue and use its official directory to choose a dining, retail, or service stop.
cards.short_summary: A mixed retail, dining, and service center beside the campus approach.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village identifies itself at 1201 University Avenue and lists shopping, dining, entertainment, and services.
cards.access_notes: See the center directory for individual business hours and access details.
